source.author: verg
source.text: Saevit medio in certamine Mavors caelatus ferro tristesque ex aethere Dirae, et scissa gaudens vadit Discordia palla, quam cum sanguineo sequitur Bellona flagello.
source.text_original: Saevit medio in certamine Mavors / caelatus ferro tristesque ex aethere Dirae, / et scissa gaudens vadit Discordia palla, / quam cum sanguineo sequitur Bellona flagello.
source.text_english: Mars, wrought in iron, rages in the midst of the battle, and the grim Furies descend from the sky, and Discord, rejoicing, goes with her robe rent, whom Bellona follows with her blood-red whip.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: via facta per undas perque hiemes, Bellona, tibi.
reuse.text_original: via facta per undas / perque hiemes, Bellona, tibi.
reuse.text_english: a road made through the waves and through the winters, O Bellona, for you.
